browser: The user's stable Google Chrome, driven through the official Claude in Chrome extension in its own tab-group window. Held keys were synthetic in-page keydown/keyup events; held touch buttons were pointer events on the real touch buttons; Start, language, Play again and level-select clicks were real mouse clicks or in-page key presses. Only visible DOM text and canvas pixels were read; no game state was read or injected.
savedProgressSeeding: Later levels were opened from the level-select screen after earlier runs had unlocked them through the host's own saved progress.
phoneLayouts: The Chrome window could not be resized, so phone layouts were checked in a same-origin 390-wide portrait frame on the page.
servedSourceCheck: Before the final Firefly Trail runs, the SHA-256 of the served src/games/firefly-trail.js was computed in the page and matched the approved hash, and the module was fetched from the network rather than the cache.

observed: A driver that reads only the status-line prompt and the drawn kitchen won all 22 shifts; the last shift ended at 80% satisfaction with '所有班次都完成了，这间厨房属于你！'.
An idle shift ended in a loss; the win and loss screens ignored input, and Play again opened a clean shift-select screen.
English two-player phone layout: both chefs moved independently from their own touch buttons.
Every shift lost during the runs was traced to the test driver, not the game.
notes: The green reach bar marks the prompted station, but Space uses whichever station is nearest, so a chef standing a few pixels off-centre between two crates can take from the wrong one. The game follows its documented rule; recorded, not fixed.

observed: Approved build: a prompt-following driver played meadows 19 to 24 back to back and reached the win screen ('完成得漂亮！', score 5202) with no lost light. Clear times were 34 s on meadow 19 (dawn 64 s), 56 s on 23 (dawn 110 s) and 38 s on 24 (dawn 76 s). The status log showed no wait/flee back-and-forth.
Approved build: idle play on meadow 1 lost with 'Dawn broke over meadow 1 before the quota was met.'; arrow, Space and X on the loss screen changed nothing, and Play again returned to meadow select.

Round-3 build (e7129bc3, same layout and rendering; round 4 changed only prompt timing): the Chinese driver cleared meadows 2 to 24 and reached the win screen; the English select screen listed all 24 meadows and meadow 18 was cleared in English; an English dawn loss and restart worked.
Round-3 build, phone frame at 386 px wide with no horizontal overflow, in English and Chinese: touch labels were translated, and the touch buttons alone cleared meadow 1.
notes: The shelf language switched from Chinese to English after the final win, without a click from the test; the open win screen re-rendered in English correctly.

console: No console errors on the approved Firefly Trail runs. Earlier sessions saw only NotFoundError from setPointerCapture on synthetic touches with no real pointer behind them.
limitations: Physical phones, touch hardware, other browsers and audio were not tested. Snowball Siege's rebuild is still in review and is not part of this release.
